description:
An accomplished Career Coach and MBA specialist with 16 years of end-to-end experience in guiding students and professionals through complex career transitions, higher education choices, and MBA admissions across India. Currently working with upGrad as a Career Coach, this professional blends deep industry knowledge with structured mentoring to help learners choose the right programs, upskilling paths, and B-schools aligned to their long-term goals.​

Known for a practical, market-driven approach, the coach has advised a wide spectrum of candidates—from fresh graduates to mid-career professionals—on entrance exams, profile building, program selection, and post-MBA career planning. With strong communication skills and a coaching style that is empathetic yet straightforward, they specialise in breaking down complex choices into clear, actionable roadmaps that maximise career growth and return on investment.​

At upGrad, the focus is on personalised one-on-one guidance, goal clarity, and ongoing support, ensuring every learner feels supported from the first counselling conversation to final admission or career transition. This combination of rich on-ground counselling experience and exposure to modern, tech-enabled education platforms makes this Career Coach a trusted partner for anyone serious about accelerating their career through the right MBA or upskilling journey.
